sloka: आक्षिप्य च शिलास्तेषां निजघ्नू राक्षसा हरीन्।तेषां चाच्छिद्य शस्त्राणि जघ्नू रक्षांसि वानराः ।। ६.६९.५९ ।।
transliteration: ākṣipya ca śilāsteṣāṁ nijaghnū rākṣasā harīn।teṣāṁ cācchidya śastrāṇi jaghnū rakṣāṁsi vānarāḥ ।। 6.69.59 ।।

translations.english: In the battlefield both Vanaras and Rakshasas struck at one another with their head, rocks and swords and emitted lion roar.
